meta.title: 7 Days Best Of Central Vietnam
meta.description:
Explore the cultural heart of Vietnam with this 7-day Central Vietnam package. Wander through Hoi An’s lantern-lit streets, cruise through Hue’s imperial history, and marvel at the caves of Phong Nha. With scenic transfers over the Hai Van Pass, this tour blends culture, history, and nature.

View the full tour details & pricing: https://localvietnam.com/tour/7-days-best-of-central-vietnam/

🔹 Tour highlights:

Hoi An Basket Boat & Cycling Tour
My Son Sanctuary
Hai Van Pass Transfer
Hue City Tour
Day Trip to Phong Nha

✅ Perfect for: History buffs, families, and culture-focused travelers
📍 Operated by: Local Vietnam – trusted local travel experts
